newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Life,super offices' tax study deadline extended.
newsitem.headline: NZ Life,super offices' tax study deadline extended.

text.p: The government has extended until March the reporting deadline for the joint public and private sector working party on the taxation of life office and superannuation fund savings, Revenue Minister Bill Birch said on Thursday.
"The ... working party is looking at alternatives to the present tax treatment of savings products offered by life offices and superannuation funds," Birch said.
"Under the present system tax on this income is paid by life offices on behalf of savers at a rate of 33 percent.
"That could disadvantage low-income and middle-income savers."
He said development of options to address the problem had taken longer than expected, so the reporting deadline had been extended to March.
It was originally scheduled to report before Christmas.
